subject: Lots of changes to the new neopixel support (#489)
message:
Lots of changes to the new neopixel support (#489)

* Lots of changes to the new neopixel support

- Set attributes to update locally when making changes.  This makes the interface more responsive instead of waiting for the state to refresh.  Changes are now reflected instantly.

- Implement dimming with colors.  Previously, dimming would revert to white only, regardless of what the separate rgbw values were.  Now, it will scale with whatever the brightest value is, so a value of 128,50,5,0 at 50% will scale to 255,100,10,0 at 100%.

- Fix brightness calculation.  Brightness used to be calculated based on the white value.  Now, it's based on the brightest of rgbw.

- Fix on off functionality.  There was a bug where a brightness value of 0 could never be set, even when the led was off.  Now, there is a check to see if the light is off before converting the decimal value of brightness to a 255 based value.

* Clean up leftover variable

* Tweak tests to test dimming of colors.

* adding a test for the b led

subject: Allow offline printers, skip error messages (#739)
message:
Allow offline printers, skip error messages (#739)

* Add logging for unreachable Moonraker connections

* Add option for quiet unreachable in config flow

* Add constant for quiet unreachable devices

* Add description for quiet unreachable devices

* Add translation for quiet unreachable devices

* Update connection.rst

* Enhance tests for unreachable printer logging

Added tests for handling unreachable printers and logging behavior.

* Fix indentation in bypass_connect_client_fixture

* Replace _log_unreachable with _LOGGER.warning

* Implement test for setup entry exception logging

Add test for handling setup entry exceptions with quiet mode enabled.

* Refactor port handling for Moonraker connection

* Use DEFAULT_PORT for empty port in connection test

* Add default port constant for connection data

* Add tests for normalize_moonraker_port function

* Fix formatting in _async_is_tcp_reachable function

* Fix tests broken by offline TCP reachability probe

The offline-support feature added a real TCP reachability check in
async_setup_entry, but only test_init.py mocked it. Every other platform
test (sensor, switch, number, etc.) failed to set up its config entry
because the probe could not reach the mocked host.

Centralize the bypass in conftest.py so all tests treat the endpoint as
reachable by default, and add tests covering the new code paths
(_async_is_tcp_reachable plus the unreachable branches in fetch/send) to
restore 100% coverage.
